packageJson.name: zod

packageJson.description: TypeScript-first schema declaration and validation library with static type inference

scripts.bump:beta: pnpm version "v$(pnpm pkg get version | jq -r)-beta.$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)"
scripts.pub:beta: pnpm bump:beta && pnpm publish --tag next --publish-branch v4 --no-git-checks --dry-run
